source: Berkshire East 2024 trail map by E. R. Oyen (skimap.org map 30668; checked against the 2026 version, map 39213), read by hand
note: Little Mohawk is blue at the top and green lower down; the whole run takes the harder rating. Upper Exhibition is freestyle terrain on the map; it is listed at the OpenStreetMap rating (blue) so that Exhibition's green does not carry over to it. Gronk Glades and Horace's Grove are not in OpenStreetMap yet.
